result.title: Can a Frontier LLM Repair a Quantized Network by Tool-Free Weight-Space Programming?
result.comment: 14 pages, 9 figures. Code and prompts on GitHub (weight-space-programming-ptq): https://github.com/urbste/weight-space-programming-ptq
result.summary: We give four large language models (LLMs) of the Claude family the complete weights of a 20k-parameter CIFAR-10 CNN as text and ask them to produce a 4-bit network without tools, data or the ability to run inference. Standard round-to-nearest (RTN) quantization to 4 bit lowers the test accuracy from 81.4% to 60.4%. We design four evaluation protocols that differ in the input and task description given to the LLMs and analyze their responses. In the first two protocols the LLMs are given the float and the 4-bit RTN network and are told that the accuracy has dropped significantly. In the last two they receive only the float network and the task to quantize it, which tests whether they apply an optimization on their own or fall back to plain RTN. Our analysis shows that a frontier LLM can recover most of the lost accuracy. Given one answer per layer, Opus 5.5 raises the accuracy of the 4-bit network to 77.95% by balancing the rounding errors within each 3x3 kernel, reasoning over the integer weights without tools. This is 3.5 pp below the float network and 2.8 pp below AdaRound, which learns the rounding from calibration data. Given only the float network, the LLMs name error-cancelling corrections but do not apply them and fall back to plain RTN, at most with mildly clipped scales, which still lifts Fable 5.2's quantized network to 70.0%. We analyze in detail what the LLMs did and why it works. Code and prompts can be found at https://github.com/urbste/weight-space-programming-ptq

AI.brief_summary: 论文将 20k 参数 CIFAR-10 CNN 的全部权重以文本形式交给 Claude 系列 LLM，在无工具、无数据、不能运行推理的条件下要求直接给出 4-bit 量化网络，并用四种协议分析其修正行为，其中 Opus 5.5 通过在每个 3x3 kernel 内平衡舍入误差把精度从 60.4% 恢复到 77.95%。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理主线无直接关系，但「能说出误差抵消的修正却不实际施加」这一现象，可能为 LVR 中「内部计算内容是否真被答案使用」以及无反馈条件下的代价分配问题提供类比线索，可供核查。
